backlog.title: Test req.range() edge cases
backlog.intent: Add a new test file covering req.range() cases the existing tests miss: several ranges with { combine: true }, overlapping and out-of-order ranges, an unsatisfiable range, a malformed Range header, and a size of 0. Only add tests; if one exposes a real bug, say so in the commit message instead of changing lib/.

backlog.title: Test res.vary() edge cases
backlog.intent: Add a new test file covering res.vary() cases the existing tests miss: an empty array, the same field twice, fields differing only in case, a Vary header already set by earlier middleware, and "*". Only add tests.

backlog.title: Test res.status() with invalid codes
backlog.intent: Add a new test file checking how res.status() treats invalid codes in Express 5: non-integers, numbers out of range, numeric strings, and undefined. Assert the errors it throws (type and message) as the code actually behaves today.

backlog.title: Complete the JSDoc in lib/view.js
backlog.intent: Give every function and method in lib/view.js complete, accurate JSDoc: what it does, each parameter with its type, the return value, and what it throws. Documentation only: no change in behavior, and the tests must still pass.

backlog.title: A health-check example
backlog.intent: Add an example app in examples/health/index.js, in the style of the other examples, serving GET /healthz with JSON { status: "ok", uptime: <seconds> } and a 404 for anything else, plus an acceptance test for it in test/acceptance/health.js like the other acceptance tests.

backlog.title: Test app.locals and res.locals together
backlog.intent: Add a new test file showing how app.locals and res.locals combine when rendering: res.locals overriding app.locals, values set by middleware, and a mounted sub-app with its own app.locals. Use the test fixtures the existing render tests use. Only add tests.
